settings.text:
❐ §aDefault Experience§r: The normal look for Odyssey with custom PBR and textures, this is the intended way to enjoy Odyssey.

❐ §eNew PBR§r: This version of the pack includes brand new PBR and improved vanilla textures. [ This is still in a early stage and not complete].

❐ §2§lNON-PBR/Compatibility§r: This version of Odyssey doesn't have the custom PBR or textures but uses the default PBR/textures from vanilla. When this is selected, the game will use textures from any pack under Odyssey.
